decisive_items: an absolute eosinophil count of 1,570 cells/µL (normal 40–190)
the absolute eosinophil count rose further
response.rationale: Elevated absolute eosinophil count and rising eosinophil count suggest eosinophilic pneumonia, which is more specific than Loeffler syndrome

rejected.why: Viral myopericarditis does not explain the elevated eosinophil count and pulmonary nodules
Toxocariasis is possible but not as directly supported by the laboratory findings as eosinophilic pneumonia
Toxocara infection is similar to Toxocariasis and has the same limitations
Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection is contradicted by the negative PCR result
